raw_block.rationale: Create a grounded terminal for §3306(c)(5)(A). The supplied relation [Alice, father, Bob] means Alice has father Bob; therefore Bob performs service in the employ of his child Alice, which the statute excludes from employment. The program recognizes this without inventing or binding an inverted family fact.
